hypothesis: Replace heap-backed OnceLock AtomicI8 widths with const-zero AtomicU8 BSS storage. Zero means unasked, width+1 means Some(width), 255 means None. Same width policy and relaxed loads/stores, no eager table or changed row loop. char index is safe. No unsafe code.

engine.screen: Unicode median CPU throughput >=1.02, positive sign direction, six-workload Holm p<.05, and all six CPU paired point medians >=.98. No engine-only promotion.

cold.method: Fresh process per exact ignored cold test, one first lookup of U+754C. Thread CPU ns, wall ns, process minor-fault and maxrss deltas around only this lookup; width must agree with unicode_width. Tests common to both arms, no allocation instrument. Analyze per-pair cold CPU ns and minor faults descriptively; no broad memory or startup claim.
cold.stop: Exactly 30 cold processes. No discarded samples or hot series rescues. maxrss high-water deltas are not current RSS.

follow_on: Only if engine clears, freeze new full terminal protocol with fresh control/candidate/Ghostty 30 six-permutation rounds and separately specified acceptance/replication. No new terminal timings after failed engine gate.
correctness: Candidate exhaustive width test plus parser differential suite on exact executable; restored runtime test only if restored. Cold diagnostic is ignored and deterministic first-value check, not a performance pass criterion.
stop: One candidate, fixed count. Reject on failed warm gate even if cold latency improves; restore runtime bytes, no variants, repeats, pooling, cherry-picking ASCII/truecolor. Keep cold evidence.
limits: Shared host. No own builds during measurements, no host job termination, governors, cache dropping, producer pinning. Layout and shared-host variation remain. Fastest-of-five CPU test diagnostic is not DA1 end-to-end throughput. Static BSS adds virtual mapping; fault/RSS deltas do not show total retained memory.
